name: flock
description: Build knowledge graphs and explore synthetic social simulations from inside Codex.

interface.longDescription: Turn source documents into a cited knowledge graph, simulate synthetic communities in Reddit-like or Twitter-like spaces, explore interactive local visualizations, and create reports inside a supported agent host. The active host session performs model reasoning, while each user configures their own host and provider access. Flock's model-free helper stores graph and run history in the chosen workspace. No separate Flock API key, Zep key, external graph service, or local web app is required.
defaultPrompt: Use Flock to build a source-grounded graph or simulate a synthetic community in this workspace.
